No place is stated for 1980, so np, although the family trade was in Paris. Thomas Salomon (4th generation) joined in 2000. Legal notice: publisher YVES SALOMON FOURREUR, Paris, with Yves Salomon as legal representative. Store locator, US entries: Yves Salomon Aspen, 200 S. Mill St (O) and Bergdorf Goodman, 754 5th Ave (D). W: the site prices in euros, and its shipping policy offers delivery 'in Europe and worldwide'. The quote is from the brand's own English version of the page (original in French). Lookbook: the 'Fall Winter Collection for Women' shop page, label 'Fall Winter' (no year on the page); there is also a 'Back to the city 2026' story page. Signature NONE: the site has an 'Iconics' group of trench coats and parkas but no single style. The site also sells fur, which may matter for the page's framing.
